profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer specializing in Full-Stack Development
profile.summary:
🚀 Crafting Digital Experiences: A Decade of Mastery

🌟 Hello, I'm Eric Schmuecker —a seasoned web developer with over 10 years of hands-on experience in the ever-evolving world of technology. My passion lies in building custom full-stack web applications that seamlessly blend creativity, functionality, and user delight.

🔍 What Sets Me Apart:
- Self-Motivated Explorer: I thrive on challenges. As a self-taught professional, I've honed my skills by diving headfirst into complex problems and emerging victorious. Curiosity fuels my journey.
- Agile Adaptability: The tech landscape never stands still, and neither do I. My quick-learning mindset allows me to stay ahead of the curve, embracing new tools and frameworks with enthusiasm.
- User-Centric Approach: I don't just write code; I craft experiences. My work marries technical prowess with a deep understanding of usability and efficiency. The result? Awesome applications that users love.

🛠️ My Toolbox:
- Angular 12+ and React: My canvas for front-end magic.
- Typescript, Node.js, and JavaScript​: The building blocks of innovation.
- CSS, HTML, and SASS: Where aesthetics meet functionality.
- Webpack and NPMJS: Streamlining development.
- GraphQL: Empowering efficient data communication.
- MSSQL: Taming databases.
- Twitter Bootstrap: My trusty companion.

🌐 Let's Create Something Extraordinary:
Whether it's a sleek e-commerce platform, a dynamic dashboard, or an interactive portfolio, I'm ready to turn ideas into reality. Connect with me, and let's embark on a digital journey that leaves a lasting impact! 🚀

Remember, every line of code I write is an opportunity to shape the digital world. Let's build something remarkable together! 💡👨‍💻

positions.title: IT Support / Programmer
positions.description: Receive and/or troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, and infrastructure issues for local office and remote users.  Also, responsible for programming for proprietary software.  Programming languages consist of C#, VB .net, SQL, python, html/css, php, ajax, jscript, and DNN.  Imaging and deploying of computers.  Making sure workstations and servers are secure.  In addition to these task, also responsible for installation/configuration and troubleshooting of VoIP system.

positions.title: IT Help Desk Analyst
positions.description: Receive/troubleshoot hardware and software issues via phone or Help Desk application.  Installation, imaging and configuration of Workstations and Servers. Supply ordering and service calls for printers. Recovering of data lost one way or another.  Securing workstations and servers from outside networks.  Installation and configuration of VoIP phone systems.

positions.title: IT Salon Help Desk Analyst
positions.description: Provide technical support and customer service to individuals across North American including Canada and Puerto Rico. Installation and configuration of new hardware and software.  Programmed a graphical user interface to speed up everyday tasks.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Collecting data from devices and inputing on an online database.

positions.title: Asst. Concessions Manager
positions.description: Oversaw the operations of a traveling entertainment show.  Ordered supplies in advance from multiple vendors.  Supervised 20-40 people of various skill levels and language barriers.
